insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 279% to ₹95 Cr with an ~12% EBITDA margin and PAT of ₹6.4 Cr (a loss a year ago), helped by a shift from winding wires toward LT, HT and MVCC power cables for utilities and EPC contractors. The order book is ₹142 Cr (to be executed in about three months) plus a ₹150 Cr pipeline, and capacity rises 60% to 12,000 km a year from February 2027 for ₹15-20 Cr of capex. Management declined to give a revenue number but expects growth similar to the last two to three years; the edited transcript contradicts itself on segment margins and the target share of HT/MVCC cables.
